title: A CRITICAL REVIEW OF THE NEED FOR KNOWLEDGE–CENTRIC EVALUATION OF QURANIC RECITATION
reasoning: The paper is a critical review of technology applied to Quranic recitation (Tajweed). It specifically evaluates existing systems based on their adherence to Islamic theological principles, traditional pedagogical methods (Talaqqi), and the requirement for religious accuracy and certification (Ijaza). It discusses the intersection of faith and digital innovation, emphasizing that evaluation tools must align with the sacred and unchanging rules of Tajweed.
